title: R-7. Der Prinz Von Sparta Luis Royo Comic Images Supreme Collector Cards
descriptionText: The R-7 Der Prinz Von Sparta trading card is a highly sought-after collectible from the Supreme Collector Cards series by Comic Images. Released in 1996, this non-sport trading card features artwork by renowned illustrator Luis Royo, known for his captivating compositions in the genre of comics. With its rarity and association with a popular franchise, this card is a prized possession for collectors looking to enhance their card collection with a piece of comic history.
